jm.config:
env.java.home: "/usr/lib/jvm/java-11-openjdk"
env.java.opts.all: "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=4 -XX:+UnlockDiagnosticVMOptions -XX:+DebugNonSafepoints -XX:+PreserveFramePointer -Djava.library.path=/root/briskstate-runtime/native -Xlog:gc*,safepoint:file=/root/briskstate-runtime/jm/log/gc-%p.log:time,uptime,level,tags:filecount=4,filesize=64M"
jobmanager.rpc.address: "127.0.0.1"
jobmanager.rpc.port: 6123
jobmanager.bind-host: "127.0.0.1"
jobmanager.memory.process.size: "8g"
taskmanager.host: "127.0.0.1"
taskmanager.bind-host: "127.0.0.1"
taskmanager.rpc.port: 0
taskmanager.data.port: 0
taskmanager.resource-id: "briskstate-jm"
taskmanager.cpu.cores: 4.0
taskmanager.numberOfTaskSlots: 4
taskmanager.memory.process.size: "32g"
taskmanager.memory.task.off-heap.size: "8g"
taskmanager.memory.managed.size: "256m"
taskmanager.memory.network.min: "512m"
taskmanager.memory.network.max: "512m"
parallelism.default: 8
rest.address: "127.0.0.1"
rest.bind-address: "127.0.0.1"
rest.port: 8081
rest.bind-port: "8081"
state.backend.type: "hashmap"
state.backend.forl0.l0-cache.enabled: false
state.backend.forl0.native-memory.max-size: "1g"
state.checkpoint-storage: "filesystem"
state.checkpoints.dir: "file:///root/briskstate-runtime/checkpoints"
state.savepoints.dir: "file:///root/briskstate-runtime/savepoints"
io.tmp.dirs: "/root/briskstate-runtime/jm/tmp"
